cover.title: Capstone: a small family of AEM pages
cover.overview: Create or mock a small page family that tells the same Kitepump story: one parent, two children, Title / Text / Image / Teaser, no DITA dumped into Text.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled window if the app cannot open.

blocks.body: Create or mock a small page family that tells the same Kitepump story: one parent, two children, Title / Text / Image / Teaser, no DITA dumped into Text.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 110 minutes. Next you will learn The Sites half, then do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.
You just named today's job. Now the idea: The Sites half. Then you will do the lab.

blocks.heading: The Sites half
blocks.body:
Same product. Different model. Pages, not topicrefs.

- One **parent**
- Two **children**
- **Title, Text, Image, Teaser**
- A real **alt** phrase
- No handbook XML in Text

You may not have AEM. A labeled mock plus a field log is the lab. Quick Publish on a real instance if you have one.

The page sells the beach card. The book explains how. They share a name, not a file format.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Sites half of the capstone.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You paste a DITA how-to into the Text block, or the family has one orphan page with no parent.

Expected: Three pages (or mocks). Blocks used as taught. Payload written.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Sites half of the capstone.
blocks.intro: How to Sites half of the capstone. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Sites half of the capstone
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Parent page: Kitepump (title). Child: Beach use. Child: Where to buy (or mock names).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Blocks: Title, Text, Image with a real alt phrase, Teaser linking parent to child.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: Pasting the DITA how-to into Text keeps the capstone as one story. True or not?
options: True :  one story means one file
Not true :  same product, two desks. Rewrite for the page. Link to the help if you must
True if you hide the tags
blocks.why: One product story. Two models. Do not dump the handbook into the hero.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: How do you connect parent to child on the web page?
options: A Teaser (or another real link) on the parent, pointing at the child
blocks.why: Pages point with links and teasers. Maps point with topicrefs. Different desks.
